title: Dadaísta · los dados
description: Dadaísta (docs/animas/dadaista/), the university friends' ánima: its maná is dice, floating beside whoever wears it and shown on the plate. Golpe de dados lands by the face of the die spent; Doble o nada rolls it again for a double blow or nothing. A skill always spends its die, and the rare Joker lands as the best case on every foe. Gerard wears it in the fight tester beside Aitor's Matemágico, against two sturdy dogs. Run it with --gpu.

steps.eval: window.ui = window.gerard.battleUI; window.turn = id => document.querySelector('#battle .turn-meta')?.textContent === 'TU TURNO' && document.querySelector('.battle-dock[data-dock="1"]')?.dataset.member === id; ui.tweak(s => s.foes.forEach(f => { f.hp = f.maxHp = 400; }));
ui.tweak(s => { const g = s.allies.find(a => a.id === 'gerard'); g.dice = [6, 3, 1]; g.secondary = 3; });

steps.caption: Dadaísta: its maná is dice. Three points, three dice floating beside Gerard, the same faces on his plate. At rest each one sways on its own
Idle: nobody is doing anything and the dice drift, bob and turn a little, each at its own pace
Its two skills at level 1, each spending a die: Golpe de dados and Doble o nada
Golpe de dados: the sheet turns into the hand. The die under the cursor comes forward beside Gerard
Then whom: the six, at the first dog
Golpe de dados with the six: the hand goes up, the die flies tumbling, lands and bounces off. The higher the face, the harder it lands
Doble o nada: which die to bet. A one cannot lose; a three wins with three or more
Doble o nada on the one: the die goes up, comes down showing what it rolled, and the bet won it lands twice

steps.eval: ui.tweak(s => { const g = s.allies.find(a => a.id === 'gerard'); g.dice = [6, 2]; g.secondary = 2; s.seed = 9; });

steps.caption: Doble o nada on the six, lost: it rolls a two. No blow, and the die drops and is gone: a skill always spends its die

steps.eval: ui.tweak(s => { const g = s.allies.find(a => a.id === 'gerard'); g.dice = [4, 7, 2]; g.secondary = 3; });

steps.caption: The Joker: now and then a die comes as black lacquer with a vermilion star, in the hand and on the plate
The die picker names it: it lands as a six, on everyone
Golpe de dados with the Joker: a six's blow, and it falls on both dogs

steps.eval: ui.tweak(s => { const g = s.allies.find(a => a.id === 'gerard'); g.dice = [2]; g.secondary = 1; });

steps.caption: Defender: two points of maná back, two new dice dropping into the hand
